 Versus
Vinay Shankar Pandey & another
--Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for the 
petitioners.
2. Petitioners allege willful and deliberate non￾compliance of the order dated 06.07.2026 passed 
in WPSS No.2347 of 2025, Akshay Lal & another 
vs. State of Uttarakhand & Others, whereby 
respondents were directed to complete the 
exercise of granting the benefit of upgradation to 
the petitioners to the pay scale of Rs. 9,300–
34,800 (Grade Pay Rs. 4,200/- with effect from 
15.04.2010), within a period of two months from 
the date of production of a certified copy of the 
order.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits 
that petitioners supplied copy of the order 
passed by the Writ Court to both the 
respondents on 27.07.2026, and thereafter, a 
reminder was also sent on 20.09.2026. However, 
despite lapse of the time fixed by Writ Court, the 
respondents have failed to pass any order in 
favour of the petitioners granting them the  benefit as directed by the Writ Court.
4. Issue notice to the respondents￾contemnors, returnable within four weeks.
5. Steps to be taken within three working 
days.
6. List on 03.12.2026.
7. In the meantime, respondents-contemnors
either may file counter affidavit/response or to 
comply the order passed by the Writ Court.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
09.10.2026 AK
